tracks.title: If You Have Never Done This
tracks.line: A chair, seven minutes, and no vocabulary required. The front door.

tracks.title: The Crown of Light
tracks.line: Release the body, empty the breath, and look up: a light has been waiting all day.

tracks.title: The Lamp
tracks.line: Light a real diya. Tonight the teacher is a flame the size of a thumbnail.

tracks.title: The Cave Above the Snowline
tracks.line: Seven stone steps down to a fire that was lit for you. A journey, not a lesson.

tracks.title: The Boat at Night
tracks.line: Do not sit up for this one. The voice will not come back; that is the point.
